If you enjoy building relationships, having meaningful commercial conversations and helping customers see the value in the services they use, this could be the perfect next step.

You'll manage an existing portfolio of customers, take ownership of renewals and work with key decision-makers to strengthen relationships and retain business.

This isn't a high-volume call centre role - it's a consultative, relationship-focused position where your communication skills and commercial approach will make a real difference.

Fantastic Benefits
- 31,734 basic salary + monthly performance bonus - realistic OTE 37,734
- Up to 37 days' holiday, including Bank Holidays
- Reduced August working hours - 9:30am to 3:00pm

- Building rapport with key contacts through telephone, video and email.
- Understanding customer needs, resolving concerns and handling cancellation objections.
- Discussing pricing, contracts and renewal options to retain business.
- Preparing quotations and identifying opportunities to re-engage customers.
- Maintaining accurate CRM records and managing your renewal pipeline.
- Working towards agreed retention and performance targets.

What We're Looking For
- Experience in account management, customer retention, renewals, customer success or consultative sales.
- Strong communication skills and confidence speaking with customers and decision-makers.
- A natural ability to build relationships, handle objections and negotiate effectively.
- Commercial awareness and a proactive, solutions-focused approach.

Represent the Business. Own the Relationship. Protect the Contract.

Are you a commercially minded relationship builder who enjoys managing client accounts, influencing decisions and securing long-term business partnerships? Office Angels are recruiting for a Client Retention & Renewals Executive to join a successful, established organisation based in Gateshead.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone with experience in account management, customer success, client retention or contract renewals who thrives on building trusted relationships and managing meaningful commercial conversations.

You'll take ownership of an established portfolio of clients across the UK, conducting professional meetings via video and telephone, managing contract renewals and engaging directly with key decision-makers.

This isn't a high-volume contact centre role. You'll be trusted to manage client relationships, navigate commercial discussions and secure successful renewal outcomes.

What You'll Get
- 31,734 basic salary + monthly performance-related bonus Realistic OTE 37,734
- Monday to Friday 8:30am-4:30pm No weekends
- Hybrid working after qualifying service

- Reduced August working hours - 9:30am-3:00pm, same pay

- Conducting professional client meetings via video and telephone
- Building trusted relationships with key decision-makers and stakeholders
- Understanding client requirements, objectives and potential concerns

- Re-engaging previous clients and strengthening existing relationships

You'll bring:
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills
- A polished, credible and professional approach to client relationships
- Strong commercial awareness and confidence discussing pricing, contracts and value
- Excellent relationship-building, influencing and negotiation skills
- Confidence handling objections and commercially sensitive conversations
- The ability to manage multiple client relationships and renewal opportunities
- Confidence using CRM systems, with Microsoft Dynamics or similar experience advantageous

Experience within education, public sector, technology, software or another service-led organisation would be beneficial, although not essential.

title: Accounts Assistant
description:
KCR Solutions are delighted to be recruiting an Accounts Assistant to work for this fabulous company in Newcastle. Your duties will be as follows:
- Leading the day-to-day operation of the accounts payable and receivable functions
- Ensuring supplier's invoices/credits are processed in an accurate and timely manner
- Making sure invoices are correctly matched to purchase orders, receipted goods and coded correctly
- Responsible for the supplier/expense payment runs for both UK and foreign suppliers
- Ensuring suppliers are paid on a timely basis and remittances sent out in a timely manner
- Raising sales invoices for external and internal customers
- Reconciling debtor's ledger and ensuring that payments are received on time
- Dealing with supplier and customer invoice queries in the company and externally
- Reviewing invoice queries daily and maintaining at target levels set
- Making sure supplier statement reconciliations are completed quickly and efficiently
- Reconciling and distributing customer statements
- Updating and maintaining daily cash flow forecast on occasions when required
- Assisting the FC with the preparation of the monthly short term cash flow forecast
- Maintaining the GRNI account ledger ensuring the balance is materially correct at month end
- Leading monthly creditor reviews and weekly debtor reviews and raising any concerns to FC
- Assisting with the month end process; control account reconciliations, KPI Trackers
- Assisting the FC with EC sales/intrastat returns and government grant claims
- Responsible for ensuring that all credit card expenditure is recorded

You will have worked in a similar role and have excellent sales and purchase ledger experience. Strong Excel is essential.

The company offer hybrid working and excellent benefits.

title: Business support officer
description:
Job Title: Business Support Officer

Temporary assignment: Up to 4 months. (Possibility to extend or convert to permanent)

Location: Newcastle

Salary: Based on 32,000 - 33,000 pa

Benefits:

Varied responsibilities across three departments, training available and exposure to engineering projects. Initial temporary assignment of approximately three to four months, with potential for a permanent opportunity, although this is not guaranteed.

The Company:

Theo James Recruitment is supporting a manufacturing and engineering business seeking a Business Process Support colleague to help its teams manage a busy workload.

Working alongside purchasing, engineering and programme management colleagues, you will contribute to day-to-day operations and help improve how information and documentation are organised.

Working Hours:

Monday - Friday - Office-based position.

Job Description:

As Business Process Support, you will coordinate administrative activities across Purchasing, Programme Management and Quality, keeping information accurate and following up on outstanding actions.

Your responsibilities will include:
- Raising sales orders, processing enquiries and issuing order acknowledgements.
- Supporting contract reviews by arranging discussions and maintaining checklists.
- Processing purchase orders and requisitions.
- Chasing suppliers and deliveries, escalating risks to schedules.
- Coordinating transport and maintaining shipment documentation.
- Updating ERP records and forecast information.
- Maintaining supplier certificates, approvals and quality documentation.
- Keeping QMS records and departmental folders organised.
- Liaising with accounts to resolve purchasing queries.
- Suggesting practical improvements to administrative processes.

The Business Process Support position involves quality administration rather than inspection. Technical, commercial and quality decisions remain with the relevant managers.

Skills & Experience:

For this Business Process Support opportunity, attitude, organisation and initiative are central to success.

We are looking for:
- Purchasing or supply-chain administration experience, ideally within manufacturing or engineering.
- Confidence chasing suppliers, influencing others and following actions through.
- Strong attention to detail and an understanding of the importance of accurate records.
- The ability to multitask and support several departments.
- A proactive approach and willingness to learn.

Epicor experience would be an advantage, although training can be provided. Experience in sales administration or document control would also be useful.

Why Should You Apply?

This Business Process Support role offers variety, involvement across multiple teams and the chance to make a visible difference to everyday operations.

You will bring organisation and initiative to a team that values a practical approach, while developing your knowledge of purchasing, programme support and quality administration.

Apply through Theo James Recruitment to discuss the Business Process Support opportunity.

title: Home Service Coordinator
description:
Home Service Coordinator

Newcastle-Under-Lyme (Hybrid working)

29,812.13 per annum pro rata

Hours per week: 37

Contract type: Fixed term until 31st March 2027

Delivering for people, dedicated to places

As our Home Service Coordinator, you'll play a vital role in ensuring our customers receive a seamless, customer-focused service across a range of housing maintenance and property-related workstreams, including repairs, voids, disrepair and compliance activity. You'll help keep customers at the heart of everything we do by ensuring services are well coordinated, efficiently managed and delivered right first time.

Working closely with customers, contractors, suppliers and internal teams, you'll coordinate activities from start to finish, ensuring appointments are scheduled effectively, work progresses smoothly and customers are kept informed every step of the way. Whether supporting a customer moving into their new home, helping to coordinate damp and mould and HHSRS interventions, arranging repairs and maintenance activity, you'll play an important role in delivering positive customer outcomes.

You'll also provide essential operational and administrative support across our maintenance services, ensuring accurate systems data, scheduling activity, timely and accurate asbestos surveys requests, processing supplier invoices and ensuring reporting and performance information are maintained. By working collaboratively across teams, responding proactively to customer enquiries and identifying opportunities for improvement, you'll help us deliver services that are simpler, slicker and smarter for both customers and colleagues.

What you'll need to succeed

We're looking for someone who is organised, customer-focused and enjoys building positive relationships with a wide range of people. You'll have experience coordinating services, managing competing priorities and delivering excellent customer service within a busy operational environment.

You'll be a confident communicator who can work effectively with customers, contractors and colleagues, ensuring information is accurate, timely and easy to understand. You'll be comfortable handling customer enquiries, resolving issues proactively and knowing when to escalate concerns to ensure the best possible outcome for our customers.

You'll have strong administrative and IT skills, with experience using housing systems to manage workloads, maintain accurate records and support performance reporting. Experience within housing, property services, maintenance, scheduling or contractor management would be advantageous, although your ability to coordinate services effectively and put customers first is what matters most.

Most importantly, you'll share our passion for delivering excellent customer experiences, embracing continuous improvement and working collaboratively to provide safe, decent homes and great services for our customers.

If you're ready to make a real difference to customers and communities, we'd love to hear from you.

In return we can offer you:
- Belonging to a team who make a difference to our community and value equality, diversity and inclusion.
- 22 days holiday + bank holidays + 3 concessionary days at Christmas
- Comprehensive employee assistance programme.
- Ongoing training and development in your role.
- A full benefits and discounts platform.
- Holiday buy, tech and annual savings schemes.
- Volunteer days.
- Competitive rates of pay.
- A generous company pension scheme.
- Wellbeing and stay safe provisions to look after you at work.

This role is subject to a basic DBS check.

NB Please note that we may interview whilst the role is live and may close this vacancy earlier than the advertised closing date if we receive a high volume of suitable applications, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible

The Boards of Aspire Housing and WHG have agreed to move forward with plans to merge, creating a new housing association with more than 32,000 homes across the Midlands.

Would you like to work for a Sunday Times Best Places to Work organisation?

We are going through an exciting period of transformation at Aspire Housing. As part of our improved way of working, we are introducing a number of new roles to support our service delivery teams.

As part of our 2026 focus and in line with our corporate plan and values, we recognise the importance of "putting the customer at the heart of what we do and getting the job right first time" for them. These new roles are an integral part of the service delivery team to meet the needs of our customers and the business.

- Previous experience in an administrative, operational support, quality, governance or similar role.
- Strong organisational skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Experience maintaining accurate records, documentation and structured processes.
- Ability to follow established procedures, checklists and control requirements.
- Ability to review information, identify gaps or inconsistencies and escalate appropriately.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills.
- Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and Word.
- A dependable and collaborative approach, with accountability for producing accurate work.

Desirable Skills and Experience
- Experience working within a Quality Management System (QMS) environment.
- Knowledge of ISO 9001 or ISO 9000 quality management principles.
- Internal audit or Quality Assurance experience.
- Document control experience.
- Governance or operational control-checking experience.
- Root Cause Analysis or continuous improvement experience.
- Reporting and data analysis experience.
- Experience working within a regulated operational environment.

title: Sales Executive
description:
We have an exciting opportunity for an experienced Internal Sales Executive to join a growing, successful business providing technical services and solutions to the UK construction industry.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys B2 B sales, outbound calling, and developing customer relationships. You ll be responsible for generating new business opportunities while also managing and growing an established portfolio of customers.

The Role

As an Internal Sales Executive, you will:
- Make proactive outbound calls to prospective B2 B customers
- Identify key decision-makers and generate new business opportunities
- Qualify prospects to understand their requirements, budgets and upcoming projects
- Book qualified appointments and opportunities for field-based Business Development Managers
- Manage and develop an existing portfolio of smaller B2 B accounts
- Re-engage dormant customers and identify opportunities to increase spend
- Identify cross-selling and up-selling opportunities
- Respond to sales enquiries, quotes and orders generated through your activity
- Maintain accurate customer and sales information within the CRM
- Build strong, long-term relationships with customers across the UK

About You

To be considered for this role, you should have:
- Previous experience within B2 B telesales, internal sales, lead generation or business development
- Proven experience making outbound calls and working towards sales targets
- Confidence overcoming objections and speaking with key decision-makers
- A strong telephone manner with excellent rapport-building and questioning skills
- The ability to identify and qualify genuine commercial opportunities
- Good organisational and time-management skills
- Experience using CRM systems and Microsoft Office
- A proactive, resilient and self-motivated approach to sales

Experience within construction supplies, plant hire, tool hire, technical services, engineering or industrial sectors would be advantageous, although this is not essential.

Previous experience as a Sales Development Representative (SDR), Appointment Setter, Telesales Executive, Internal Sales Executive or Business Development Executive would also be highly relevant.

What s on Offer
- Opportunity to work from Leeds or the Northeast
- Established portfolio of existing B2 B customers
- Genuine opportunity to generate and develop new business
- Work with an established and growing national organisation
- Support from experienced field-based Business Development Managers
- Varied role combining new business development and account management
- Excellent opportunity for long-term career development

Additional Information

This is a proactive sales position and will suit someone who genuinely enjoys picking up the phone, building relationships and creating commercial opportunities. The role has a target of approximately 35 proactive outbound calls per day, split between new business development and existing account management.

Due to the high volume of applications, we aim to respond to all candidates, although this is not always possible. If you have not been contacted within 5 days, please assume your application has not been successful on this occasion. However, we may retain your details for future opportunities.

title: Care Navigator/Medical Receptionist
description: We are looking to recruit an enthusiastic individual to join our well established reception team for 30 - 37 hours per week, working Monday to Friday between the hours of 7:45 and 18:30 You are the first voice patients hear and the first face they see when they visit the surgery. We pride ourselves on our consistent professional, compassionate and caring attitude towards all patients and visitors to the practice. The Medical Receptionist / Care Navigator role requires excellent communication, triage, prioritisation and organisational skills, along with the ability to manage a wide range of administrative tasks in a busy primary care environment. You will support patients in accessing the most appropriate service or healthcare professional, respond to day-to-day enquiries, process medication requests, and manage document scanning and workflow tasks. Patient interactions may take place face-to-face, by telephone, or through online systems, so confidence in using a variety of communication and digital platforms is essential. The role also involves providing administrative and operational support to the wider practice team, helping to ensure the delivery of safe, effective, and patient-centred care. Provide a professional, friendly and efficient first point of contact for patients and visitors. Assess and direct patient requests to the most appropriate clinician, service, or healthcare professional using agreed protocols. Manage incoming telephone calls, online requests, and face-to-face enquiries. Book, amend, and cancel appointments as required. Support patients in accessing practice and community services. Maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately. Process repeat prescription requests in accordance with practice procedures. Scan, code, and accurately file patient correspondence and clinical documentation. Process incoming and outgoing correspondence. Maintain accurate patient records and update demographic information as required. Support workflow management and ensure tasks are completed within agreed timescales. Work collaboratively with clinicians and administrative colleagues to support practice operations. Assist with the smooth day-to-day running of reception and administrative functions. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives and practice development. Participate in training and development activities as required. Adhere to practice policies, procedures, and NHS guidance.
